answer: Continuous proof-of-work identity renewal. Each agent identity must periodically submit a fresh hash puzzle whose difficulty scales with its current reputation, and rewards decay if it lets reputation wander too far from verified behavior. A false identity pays full compute cost per renewal yet earns nothing from its clone, so cloning multiplies mining kernel costs without multiplying trust. The underlying willow of accumulated history is non-transferable, making one honest identity cheaper than many hollow ones.
